before.asserts: Leaf-first ordering inserts 0 fill edges; center-first inserts binom(3,2)=3, and the center Schur complement has off-diagonal entries -t^2=-1/12 != 0.
before.claim: Direct finite count for the smallest allowed star verifies the ordering-dependent symbolic fill and a nonzero numerical Schur pattern.

after.asserts: In leaf-first order, elimination adds no fill. In center-first order, symbolic elimination adds every edge between leaves, and the actual Cholesky Schur complement has all those entries nonzero.
after.claim: Direct finite count for the smallest allowed star verifies the ordering-dependent symbolic fill and a nonzero numerical Schur pattern.

before.asserts: det(A)=-1, A has eigenvalues 1 and -1, both scalar diagonal pivots are 0, and for D=A the inverse-block threshold left side is the zero vector.
before.claim: Exact 2x2 arithmetic verifies nonsingularity, indefiniteness, rejection of both 1x1 pivots, and acceptance of the declared 2x2 pivot.

after.asserts: Every one-by-one diagonal pivot test fails, while the declared two-by-two pivot passes and gives an exact block $LDL^*$ factorization.
after.claim: Exact 2x2 arithmetic verifies nonsingularity, indefiniteness, rejection of both 1x1 pivots, and acceptance of the declared 2x2 pivot.

before.asserts: The grid has one vertex and no edges, so A_1=[4] and x^T A_1 x=4x^2; the ordering and Cholesky factor each have one entry.
before.claim: The smallest grid checks the positive-definite energy identity and the separately stated one-pivot cost case.

after.asserts: For $k=1$, the matrix and factor each have one entry.
after.claim: The smallest grid checks the positive-definite energy identity and the separately stated one-pivot cost case.
